points.description: States the reservoir characteristics needed: storage volume vs elevation (storage–elevation relation) and water surface elevation vs outflow (elevation–discharge relation).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of the two relations is given.

points.description: States the inflow hydrograph and the initial conditions (initial storage, inflow, outflow at t=0).
points.partial_credit: Half if only the inflow hydrograph or only the initial values are given.

rubric.notes: Full marks for covering most of the model items (about three of the four: storage–elevation, inflow hydrograph, elevation–outflow, initial values) in any wording. Give part marks when only one or two items are given or the ideas are vague. Give none for unrelated answers; extra wrong remarks do not cost marks.
